title: 人形机器人跳2米：破世界纪录，量产拐点来了？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Okay, we have a new world record.
segments.zh: 好的，我们有了新的世界纪录。

segments.en: I mean, this sport is raising and not breaking.
segments.zh: 我是说，这项运动在进步，而不是被打破。

segments.en: I love it though. So they managed to really get most of the underway.
segments.zh: 不过我喜欢。所以他们确实让大部分项目顺利进行。

segments.en: So yes, so this took place by the way over the weekend, right? The World Robot Games, and I think analysts have also been, and this is something of course we were covering last week.
segments.zh: 所以是的，顺便说一下，这发生在周末，对吧？世界机器人运动会，我认为分析师们也在关注，当然这是我们上周报道的内容。

segments.en: Just in terms of the conference itself, this is of course the one from Unitry, which had a vertical leap of two meters.
segments.zh: 就会议本身而言，这当然是Unitry的，它的垂直跳跃达到两米。

segments.en: As you can see, there are also very much more flexible hip flexors than we can achieve.
segments.zh: 正如你所看到的，它们的髋部屈肌也比我们所能达到的更加灵活。

segments.en: Interesting, I think before we talk about the sports achievements, more than Stanley's actually come out with, because they attended the event as well.
segments.zh: 有趣的是，我想在我们谈论体育成就之前，Stanley实际上也发布了消息，因为他们也参加了这个活动。

segments.en: Well, the World Robotics Conference, that was also underway.
segments.zh: 嗯，世界机器人会议也在进行中。

segments.en: It was a whole week of robots really, and it's interesting whether they're seeing the progress and where we're seeing, you know, are we at that inflection point where you can see some mass deployment of these humanoid robots now, right?
segments.zh: 这真的是整整一周的机器人，有趣的是，他们是否看到了进展，我们是否正处于那个拐点，现在可以看到这些人形机器人的大规模部署，对吧？
